description: This file defines the SupervisedStream interface for managing and supervising Akka stream source queues, including creation, termination, shutdown, and abort functionalities, along with an inner class for holding the source queue and supervised stream.

classes.name: SupervisedStream
classes.description: Interface for supervising an Akka stream, providing methods to create source queues, handle stream completion, shutdown, and abort operations.

classes.name: SupervisedStream.WithQueue
classes.description: Inner class holding the source queue and supervised stream, providing accessors for these components.

methods.name: sourceQueue
methods.description: Creates a source queue with supervision, returning a Source that materializes to a WithQueue object containing the queue and supervision info.

methods.name: whenComplete
methods.description: Registers a consumer to be called upon stream completion or error.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts the stream with a specified error.
